conflicts are reduced after projection. It is approximate, not an official full chart.

天ノ弱 / 164 feat. GUMI / user-supplied clean soundtrack
Audio source: 天ノ弱／164 feat.GUMI（公式)_320k.mp3 (192.936 s), supplied by the user.
Chart reference: BeatStream 天ノ弱 BEAST Lv09_480p.mp4, also supplied by the user.
Playable audio: 109-second clean MP3 edit, matching recording time 10–119 s.
ALL output samples come from the clean MP3; cabinet hit sounds and PERFECT / FULL
COMBO announcements from the video are never mixed into this track.
Four affine source segments, 24 ms crossfades, 84% gain for encoder headroom and
a short ending fade are recorded
in tools/amanojaku/audio-edit.json and amanojaku-chart.json. Stable vocal sections
use waveform alignment; repeated instrumental phrases/outro use spectral matching
and phrase continuity. Those instrumental splice points are estimates.
This recording is included for the private game and is not covered by the
MaouDamashii CC BY license. The 480p/30 fps video-reference chart preserves reviewed
hold pairs and six-position Ripples, and adapts selected STREAM paths to
direction-free FLICK. It is approximate, not an official complete cabinet chart.

回レ！雪月花 / 歌組雪月花 / user-supplied clean soundtrack
Audio source: Unbreakable Machine Doll -- Official Closing_320k.mp3 (90.048 s).
Chart reference: 【BeatStream】回レ！雪月花 BEAST_1080p.mp4, supplied by the user.
Playable audio is a byte-for-byte copy of the separate MP3. No recording hit
sounds or end-of-play announcements are extracted or mixed into it. Nine
waveform correlation anchors align the footage clock to the clean audio clock;
chart arrivals are converted to that clock, leaving the MP3 unchanged.

The 29.97 fps footage reference preserves reviewed hold groups and fixed Ripples;
square swipe notes are direction-free FLICK. It is approximate, not an official
complete cabinet chart. Included for this private game; this soundtrack is
separate from the MaouDamashii CC BY material above.
